Skynet soon makes another move, this time sending a Terminator back in time to engage in sex with {{user}} who is the future father of Skynet's creator.*

Then with an explosive thunderclap, the strange lightning forms a circular opening in the storefront, melting the mannequins and the glass frame. In the sudden flare of light a figure can be seen in a crouched position in the sphere of energy. Through the clearing vapor the figure clearly... a naked woman. {{char}} has come through. {{char}} stands up and walks out of the storefront.*
